overall_summary: Top performing Shorts on WHAT IF DAILY center around high-stakes planetary physics and time-bound catastrophic events (e.g., losing atmosphere for 5 seconds or planetary ring transformations), achieving 600-1000+ views and 50%+ average view percentages. Everyday abstract concepts (such as seeing Wi-Fi signals or sand turning to glass) underperform significantly (<50 views, low retention). Retention curves show high initial hooks (watch ratios >1.10 at 1% progress) for cosmic themes, but pacing drops around 25% progress unless continuous visual escalations are presented.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' achieved 862 Studio views, 256 minutes watched, 63.11% AVP, and maintained a 0.5875 audience watch ratio at 49% progress.
what_is_working.action: Frame hooks around explicit, brief timeframes (e.g., 'for 5 Seconds') with instant global consequences.

what_is_working.evidence: 'What If Earth Had Rings Like Saturn?' generated 1,059 Studio views, 268 minutes watched, and 50.79% AVP; 'What If Sound Could Travel Through Space?' reached 663 Studio views with 38.53% AVP.
what_is_working.action: Prioritize vast space/astronomy scale scenarios that offer dramatic visual contrast in the first 3 seconds.

what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If You Could See Every Wi-Fi Signal?' logged only 5 Studio views with 17.67% AVP; 'What If All Sand Turned to Glass?' netted only 19 Studio views.
what_to_improve.action: Eliminate low-stakes or abstract perceptual queries; pivot strictly to high-stakes macro physical transformations.

what_to_improve.pattern: Mid-Video Retention Decay in Static Visual Pacing
what_to_improve.evidence: 'What If Oceans Froze From the Bottom Up?' lost significant audience by mid-video, dropping relative retention from 0.4355 at 1% progress to 0.0620 at 49% progress.
what_to_improve.action: Introduce visual transformation milestones every 3-5 seconds to prevent narrative lull between 20% and 50% video progress.

retention_insights.drop_or_strength: Strong early hold and sustained late retention
retention_insights.evidence: 'What If Earth Lost Its Atmosphere for 5 Seconds?' retention starts at 1.389 audience watch ratio at 1% progress and stays above 0.587 at 49% progress.
retention_insights.action: Hook immediately with immediate physical collapse before explaining the underlying science.

retention_insights.evidence: 'What If All Lightning Struck At The Same Second?' maintained near-constant relative retention (~0.498) from 23% to 49% video progress.
retention_insights.action: Maintain fast-paced rapid-fire visual pay-offs throughout the core explanation to eliminate mid-video drop-off.
